questions.question: Describe how ensemble performance are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.
questions.correctAnswer: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use ensemble performance. Explain the effect in each case.
questions.correctAnswer: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how ensemble performance are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use ensemble performance in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.
questions.correctAnswer: A practical application showing understanding of how ensemble performance can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: identify specific ensemble skills (listening, balancing, following); detail both individual and group preparation; explain how to develop ensemble awareness; show understanding of different ensemble types; demonstrate understanding of AO1 criteria for ensemble. Mark scheme: AO3 (analyse and evaluate) + AO4 (knowledge and understanding) = total marks for listening; AO1 (perform) + AO2 (compose) for coursework components
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
